mapper.select: SELECT id, account_code, account_name, account_type, currency, initial_cash, available_cash, frozen_cash, status FROM quantpf_trading_account WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, account_code, account_name, account_type, currency, initial_cash, available_cash, frozen_cash, status FROM quantpf_trading_account ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT id, account_code, account_name, account_type, currency, initial_cash, available_cash, frozen_cash, status FROM quantpf_trading_account WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quantpf_trading_account (account_code, account_name, account_type, currency, initial_cash, available_cash, frozen_cash, status) VALUES (#{accountCode}, #{accountName}, #{accountType}, #{currency}, #{initialCash}, #{availableCash}, #{frozenCash}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE quantpf_trading_account SET available_cash=#{availableCash}, frozen_cash=#{frozenCash}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
